section: Iterate — change: measured C5 window layout
title: Derive recipient placement from measured C5 geometry (supersedes ADR-018)
context: The supplied envelope is 229 × 162 mm with a 100 × 45 mm right window at x120/y52. The earlier estimated band did not allow 5 mm clearance for every sheet position.
decision: Use recipient x125 and baselines61/66/71/76 mm at10.5pt; skip empty lines. Wrap sender to70mm and proportionally fit unusually tall blocks above90mm, keeping normal11pt/5mm spacing.
consequences: All11 municipality addresses remain intact with >=5mm window clearance across19 × 13.5mm sheet play. Print actual-size A4, fold horizontally, upper printed half facing out/fold down. Physical test print remains required.
rationale: Intersecting all sheet offsets gives x120–201/y52–83.5; 5mm inset leaves x125–196/y57–78.5. Real-PDF bounds and browser download checks pass; review caught sender/title overlap and its regression is now fixed.
rejected: Centred-sheet-only positioning can hide address lines when paper slides. Unbounded sender wrapping overlaps the title; bounding sender height preserves content and fixed body layout.
